name: zindex
description: Immutable diagrams for AI agents. This plugin adds the Zindex skill and the Zindex MCP server at https://api.zindex.ai/mcp.

interface.longDescription:
Immutable diagrams for AI agents. Ask ChatGPT for an architecture, a data model, a sequence diagram, a business process, a network, an org chart, a UI flow or a flowchart. Zindex saves it as a diagram you can come back to.

With Zindex, a diagram outlasts the chat it was made in. In a later chat, ChatGPT finds it by name, reads a short brief instead of the whole drawing, and sends only what changes. Agents you connect from other apps, signed in to the same Zindex workspace, work on the same diagrams.

ChatGPT describes the diagram. Zindex checks each change and draws it with code. Layout and rendering are deterministic, and no model runs inside Zindex, so the same diagram renders to the same pixels whichever agent saved it. AWS and Google Cloud architectures are drawn with each provider's icons. ChatGPT can also start from Mermaid text: a flowchart, an entity-relationship diagram or a sequence diagram.

Every change is a new numbered version, and nothing in a diagram's history can be rewritten: each version's hash covers the one before it. ChatGPT can open any version by number or date, say who saved it and from which app, and compare two versions. Each version keeps the image it was saved with, so an engine update never changes an old picture.

When you ask, ChatGPT can publish a diagram, so anyone with its link can see and copy it. It can also delete one, and you can undo a delete for 24 hours. ChatGPT asks you before each of these, unless you've chosen to always allow Zindex.

What it needs: a Zindex account. ChatGPT asks you to sign in when you connect, and you can create an account there. You choose read and write, or read only.

What it doesn't do: Zindex runs no model on your diagrams. It doesn't draw charts of data, and the only diagram text it reads is the three kinds of Mermaid above. For anything else, describe the diagram.
capabilities: Creates architecture, data model, sequence, process, network, org chart, UI flow and flowchart diagrams
Draws AWS and Google Cloud architectures with each provider's icons
Starts a diagram from a Mermaid flowchart, entity-relationship diagram or sequence diagram
Finds your saved diagrams by title, short name or brief
Edits a saved diagram by sending only the parts that change
Checks a diagram for errors before saving it
Keeps every change as a numbered version that can't be rewritten
Opens any version by number or date
Compares two versions and lists what changed
Shows who saved each version and from which app
Shows a diagram's image in the chat
Publishes a diagram, or makes it private again
Deletes a diagram, with 24 hours to undo
Reports a problem with a diagram to Zindex support
Sends Zindex a bug report, a request or other feedback, when you ask
defaultPrompt: Create a Zindex architecture diagram of a web app with an API, a Postgres database and a background worker
Add a Redis cache between the API and the database in my web app architecture diagram
List my Zindex diagrams and show me the one I changed most recently

publication.release_notes: Zindex in ChatGPT: create, find and change diagrams that keep every version, see any version's image, compare versions, and publish or delete diagrams.
